auto_context.card: This is an archived live stream from July 24, 2025, on the channel of Korone (Inugami Korone), a VTuber from hololive Gamers. The video is a multiplayer gameplay session of the co-op horror game R.E.P.O. (stylized as REPO on Steam), played together with three other hololive members: Natsuiro Matsuri, Tsunomaki Watame, and Isaki Riona. The stream is part of a group collab series tagged as #ホロREPO, and the tone is casual, lively, and comedic, consistent with Korone's energetic streaming persona. Speech will be in Japanese, with gaming callouts, character banter, and the players' VTuber names used frequently.
